title.zh: 从 Wire Bond 到Flip Chip：连接走向芯片表面
title.en: From Wire Bond to Flip Chip: connections move onto the chip surface

subtitle.zh: 当I/O密度、速度和电流不断提升，连接方式从芯片边缘走向整个芯片表面
subtitle.en: As I/O density, speed and current increase, connections move from the chip perimeter to the entire surface

body.zh: 边缘焊线的时代 Wire Bond
body.en: The era of peripheral wire bonding: Wire Bond

body.zh: 芯片引线框架/基板
body.en: Chip Lead frame / substrate

body.zh: •芯片边缘焊盘＋金属线连接
body.en: • Peripheral chip pads connected by metal wires

body.zh: • 工艺成熟，成本和返修经验丰富
body.en: • Mature process with extensive cost and rework experience

body.zh: • 对许多低速、I/O数有限的器件导线长度不是首要矛盾
body.en: • For many low-speed devices with limited I/O counts, Wire length is not the primary limitation

body.zh: •旧路线不是落后，而是曾经正好满足产品的约束
body.en: • The earlier route was not obsolete; it met The product constraints of its time

body.zh: I/O密度的压力
body.en: Pressure from I/O density

body.zh: 端子数量增加（处理器、射频、高性能器件）
body.en: More terminals (processors, RF and high-performance devices)

body.zh: 信号边沿变快
body.en: Faster signal edges

body.zh: 供电电流上升
body.en: Higher supply current

body.zh: 长路径带来的问题
body.en: Problems caused by long paths

body.zh: •导线从芯片边缘绕出，路径更长
body.en: • Wires emerge around the chip perimeter, creating longer paths

body.zh: • 占用封装高度
body.en: • Consume package height

body.zh: • 更大的电感和电阻
body.en: • Greater inductance and resistance

body.zh: • 电源噪声与信号完整性开始限制系统
body.en: • Power noise and signal integrity Begin to constrain the system

body.zh: 面阵连接的转向 Flip Chip
body.en: The shift to area arrays: Flip Chip

body.zh: 芯片（翻转）基板
body.en: Chip (flipped) Substrate

body.zh: • 凸点直接分布在芯片表面和基板之间
body.en: • Bumps lie directly between the chip surface and substrate

body.zh: • 连接不再只发生在四周，整个表面都可以布置I/O
body.en: • Connections are no longer confined to the perimeter; I/O Can be placed over the entire surface

body.zh: • 路径明显缩短
body.en: • Significantly shorter paths

body.zh: •低电感、高布线密度、取消焊线环高
body.en: • Low inductance, high routing density and no wire-loop height

body.zh: •这正是面阵互连进入高性能封装的原因
body.en: • This is why area-array interconnects entered high-performance packaging

body.zh: 新工艺的代价
body.en: The cost of a new process

body.zh: 芯片底填凸点 基板
body.en: Chip Underfill Bumps; substrate

body.zh: •需要晶圆级凸点、对准、回流或热压装配
body.en: • Requires wafer-level bumps, alignment, And reflow or thermocompression assembly

body.zh: • 芯片底部常需要底填
body.en: • Underfill is often needed beneath the chip

body.zh: • 连接变短并不等于制造更简单
body.en: • Shorter connections do not mean simpler manufacturing

body.zh: • 细间距带来共面性、空洞、翘曲和可靠性问题
body.en: • Fine pitch brings coplanarity, void, warpage And reliability issues

body.zh: 路线并没有消失
body.en: The routes have not disappeared

body.zh: Wire Bond适合• 成本更重要•功耗更重要• I/O规模较小• 低速器件
body.en: Wire Bond Suited to • Greater emphasis on cost • Greater emphasis on power consumption • Smaller I/O scale • Low-speed devices

body.zh: Flip Chip更有优势• 高密度I/O•高速路径•更好信号完整性• 适合高性能器件
body.en: Flip Chip Advantages in • High-density I/O • High-speed paths • Better signal integrity • High-performance devices

body.zh: 封装路线不是按先进程度排队而是由信号、供电、面积、热和成本共同筛选
body.en: Packaging routes are not ranked simply by technological advancement They are selected by signal, power supply, area, heat and cost together

body.zh: 更高密度更好性能面向多样的产品需求
body.en: Higher density Better performance For diverse product requirements

body.zh: 测试与材料链的重排
body.en: Reorganization of the testing and materials chain

body.zh: 晶圆端形成凸点
body.en: Form bumps on the wafer

body.zh: 基板提供对应焊盘
body.en: The substrate provides matching pads

body.zh: 装配设备控制共面性
body.en: Assembly equipment controls coplanarity

body.zh: 验证热路径和板级可靠性
body.en: Validate thermal paths and board-level reliability

body.zh: 更高的集成度也意味着更紧的共同窗口
body.en: Higher integration also means a tighter shared window

body.zh: 高密度连接把原本分散在芯片边缘的误差集中到凸点阵列、基板布线和装配对准的共同窗口里
body.en: High-density interconnections concentrate errors formerly distributed around the chip perimeter Into a shared window for the bump array, substrate routing and assembly alignment

body.zh: 芯片封装互连系统
body.en: Chip Package Interconnect System

body.zh: PACKAGECONNECTA SMARTER WORLD
body.en: PACKAGE CONNECT A SMARTER WORLD

body.zh: ENABLE
body.en: ENABLE
